_readme: HAND-MAINTAINED input of tools/build_button_catalog.py. Everything the tool can derive (sizes, roles, keys, ps_action, art used, ids) comes from the generated profile tables and the art folders; only what cannot be derived is typed here: roles vocabulary, the look of each game's OWN buttons, art origins and tag rules.
Never put game pixels, offsets or hashes here: the catalog stores OUR art plus metadata about the game's art (rule 13 of the safety invariants).
vocabulary: the controlled tag values. A tag outside it fails the tests. Where a look is not known write 'unknown' (never guess).
roles: the standard role names. xbox/ps = the names on each pad, shape/label = defaults for art of that role, ps_action = what a PlayStation pad needs (redraw | relabel | same | switch).
role_aliases: a game's own role names mapped to the standard role (AC1 draws body-part glyphs).
origins: one line of origin/licence per kind of art; art_rules (first match wins) give a PNG its kind, origin and tags; svg_rules (first match wins) give an SVG its role and detail.
art_roles: role of a PNG that no registered profile uses (the role of used art is derived from the profile). Keep empty unless the builder asks for it.

games: one entry per CONFIRMED game (Support level 'confirmed' or 'partly confirmed' on docs/games/<appid>-*.md; a test compares). families: look of the game's own buttons (native_look) and, only where it differs from the tags of our art, what we put there (ps_look). Key = family id the builder derives, or '<family>/<role,role>' for a role-specific entry (most specific wins). manual_slots: for games that draw no art of ours (switch strategies), whose slots cannot be derived from a table.

style.ps: PlayStation look (cross circle square triangle, L1/R2, OPTIONS/SHARE)
style.xbox: Xbox look (A B X Y, LB/RT, Menu/View)
style.neutral: no console look (tinted by the profile, or a picture without buttons)

shape.bumper: shoulder button (curved or slanted pill, usually with a word)
shape.trigger: trigger (trapezoid or tall rectangle, usually with a word)
shape.stick-cap: thumbstick (round cap, ring or press symbol)
shape.text: bare text without a button body
shape.glyph: bare symbol or label drawn onto the game's own shape (white-on-transparent mask)
shape.icon: pictogram that is not a standard button (AC1 body-part glyphs)

shading.jewel-3d: glossy gem-like pixel shading (the game's own SFH tooltip buttons)
shading.pixel-bevel: hand-pixelled edge light/dark (bevel) and a 1 px outline

label.letter: a single letter (A, B, X, Y, L, R)
label.word: a word or code (LB, L2, OPTIONS, START)
label.icon: a drawn icon (menu lines, play arrow, share, body part)

background.dark: dark body or dark surface behind the glyph
background.transparent: no body: transparent around the glyph
background.mixed: several body colours in the same family (e.g. black, orange and grey-blue)

colour.xbox-colours: A green, B red, X blue, Y yellow
colour.ps-symbol-colours: filled in by the builder from region_glyphs.PS_COLORS
colour.mono-white-mask: white mask, tinted by the profile when drawn
colour.mixed: several colours without a console scheme

ps_action.redraw: new symbol drawn (cross circle square triangle, OPTIONS, SHARE, controller picture)
ps_action.relabel: new text drawn (LB becomes L1, RT becomes R2, L3)
ps_action.same: identical on a PlayStation pad: left alone
ps_action.switch: the game already ships a PlayStation version: the plugin only selects it, no art of ours

kind.vector: SVG in assets/svg (rendered at any size)
kind.mask: white-on-transparent PNG tinted and fitted when drawn
kind.pixel: native-size RGBA PNG that replaces a whole tiny texture
kind.picture: whole-picture RGBA PNG placed in a box

lstick.name: left stick (cap, ring or all directions)
lstick.label: letter

lstick_neutral.name: left stick at rest (one state of a directional set)
lstick_neutral.label: none

rstick.name: right stick (cap, ring or all directions)
rstick.label: letter

rstick_neutral.name: right stick at rest (one state of a directional set)
rstick_neutral.label: none

head: y
AC1 eagle-vision glyph (Y)
ls: AC1 / older name of the left stick
rs: AC1 / older name of the right stick

origins.svg-set-ps: PlayStation-style icon set (third-party, open-licensed; the Sony marks are theirs; licence stated as open by the project owner, 2026-11-24; exact licence name not recorded), split into one SVG per icon by tools/split_svg_sheet.py
origins.svg-set-xbox: Xbox-style icon set (third-party, open-licensed; the Microsoft marks are theirs; licence stated as open by the project owner, 2026-11-24; exact licence name not recorded), split into one SVG per icon by tools/split_svg_sheet.py
origins.our-drawing: drawn by this project: PIL shapes rendered by tools/qb_build.py (render_masks)
origins.montserrat-ofl: label text set in Montserrat Bold (SIL OFL 1.1, py_modules/button_glyphs/masks/OFL-Montserrat.txt) by tools/qb_build.py
origins.owner-pixel-art: the project owner's own PlayStation pixel art (stated by the owner, 2026-11-24), sliced and fitted to the texture size by tools/sfh_art.py; some labels use the 3x5 pixel font drawn for that tool
origins.owner-line-art: the project owner's own DualSense line drawing (stated by the owner, 2026-11-24), cut out and scaled by tools/qb_controller_art.py

font-colour.note: font glyphs: head (Y yellow), weapon hand (X blue), empty hand (B red), legs (A green); our PlayStation style uses coloured outline icons

font-white.note: white font atlas, our art is tinted white

hud-a.note: Xbox 360 A button of the HUD (64x64); its look was not recorded on the page

area-white.note: Conrtols_*_Map, the white Xbox 360 button art of the area archives (only the PlayStation style redraws it)

area-colour.note: Conrtols_*_Color_Map, the coloured Xbox 360 button art (absent in Present_Room)

area-pad.note: Conrtols_{Left,Right}Joystick_Map 32x32 and Conrtols_{Left,Right}Trigger_Map 32x64, Animus room only; look not recorded

builtin-ps-set.note: the game's own PlayStation set (cross circle square triangle, L1/R1/L2/R2/L3/R3, OPTIONS/SHARE, red D-pad), chosen by one byte; looks not recorded

spr-ps4.note: spr_XboxButtons (523) and spr_PS4Buttons (524) are 64x64 sprites of 12 frames; which frame is which button and their look were not recorded

manual_slots.note: frame layout of the 12 frames not recorded
frame layout of the 12 frames not recorded
frame layout of the 12 frames not recorded

prompts:disc.note: flat discs in black, yellow-orange or grey-blue (hud scales 75/100/150/200); the glyph is a hole, one colour or the role colour; we keep the disc and redraw the glyph

prompts:letter.note: bare coloured letters A B X Y (no disc) in the key legend; redrawn as bare symbols

prompts:trig.note: trapezoid in black, yellow-orange or grey-blue with LT / RT; relabelled L2 / R2

prompts:bump.note: slanted bar in black, yellow-orange or grey-blue with LB / RB; relabelled L1 / R1

videoplayer_controls:disc.note: the video player's back button: black disc with a red B, becomes a red circle

controller:picture.note: Xbox One pad drawing of the options screen (white body, steel-grey buttons) replaced by the owner's DualSense drawing

pad/a,b,x,y.note: controller sheet BTN_PS3_S (Xbox art despite the name); the page does not describe its look, the icons chosen suggest coloured rings

pad/lb,rb.note: LB / RB on the controller sheet

pad/lt,rt.note: LT / RT on the controller sheet

pad/l3,r3.note: L3 / R3 on the controller sheet

pad/start,select.note: START / BACK on the controller sheet

cockpit/x,y,b.note: cockpit_arts_btn: X / Y / B beside the attack commands; the B has a glow

continue/a.note: the big A of the continue screen (2048x1024 texture), normal and pressed

tip_face.note: tooltip A/B/X/Y: glossy 11 px gems in green, red, blue and yellow; ours: dark discs with a coloured symbol

tip_dpad.note: dark-grey pad; the Up/Down/Left/Right textures light one arm yellow with rays

tip_stick.note: left-stick tooltips: cap in a well, the pushed direction in yellow; left alone

tip_label/lb,rb.note: tooltip LB / RB: dark letters over a grey crescent; ours: a dark rounded bumper with L1 / R1 (3x5 pixel font)

tip_label/lt,rt.note: tooltip LT / RT: dark letters beside a grey tall rectangle; ours: a dark square-cornered trigger with L2 / R2 (3x5 pixel font)

tip_start.note: tooltip START: a pill with a play arrow and the word START under it; ours: a pill with the menu lines

menu_face.note: menu A/B/X/Y: 13 px coloured gems with a letter; ours: 13 px dark discs with a coloured symbol

menu_arrow.note: menu D-pad arrows 17x15, light grey; left alone

menu_label/lb,rb.note: menu LB / RB: grey flat bumper with a white word; ours: dark pill with L1 / R1

menu_label/lt,rt.note: menu LT / RT: grey flat pill with a white word; ours: dark square-cornered trigger with L2 / R2

menu_stick.note: menu L / R stick caps 13x13 (and the misspelled Menu/xbox/rstrick duplicate); left alone

menu_symbol.note: menu START / BACK: grey flat pill with a white arrow icon; ours: dark pill with the menu lines / share icon
